summary: The HyperFrames audio analysis and automation modules provide production-grade, pure-TypeScript signal processing: ITU-R BS.1770 loudness, 4× oversampled true-peak, spectral-flux onsets, moment detection, silence spans, and a conic-curve automation system with via-points that beats simple exponent curves. A provider ladder adds robust fallbacks (local/fast/best). All runs in Node, Bun, or browser

Moment detection (onset/steepest/peak/tailEnd)
